title: Flood zone and building permit appeals continued
summary: On July 23, the board voted to continue two combined notice-of-violation appeals to December 10th, 2026, after receiving an agreement between both sides to delay four to six months. The appeals challenge violations for building in a special flood hazard area without a flood development permit and for building or renovating without a building permit. The case has been on the calendar six years; the appellants are hiring an archaeologist for a survey the planning department requested.
